description.value: Hula Poké is a Hawaiian-inspired fast-casual poke bowl chain growing across Western Canada, offering fully customizable bowls built on coconut rice, sushi rice, or kelp noodles with proteins ranging from raw-marinated ahi tuna and salmon to tofu and sweet potato. Their Richmond outpost sits within the McArthurGlen Designer Outlets near YVR, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the airport corridor. The menu spans ten-plus globally-inspired bowl flavours and includes a line of fruit-infused coconut water drinks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Hula Poké, a Hawaiian-inspired poke bowl chain. Two Richmond locations appear on the locations page: McArthurGlen Outlets (1204-7899 Templeton Station Rd, 604-242-2161) and YVR Airport (post-security WestJet Departures, 604-214-6626); given the OSM coordinates and public accessibility, the McArthurGlen location is the more likely match, but this is uncertain. The menu explicitly labels numerous dishes 'VEGAN FRIENDLY' and 'GLUTEN FRIENDLY', and 'SKIP THE LINE & ORDER AHEAD / ORDER HERE' confirms takeout ordering; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Hula' but the business operates as 'Hula Poké' on all website branding — possible truncation in OSM.

Two Richmond locations listed on the website (McArthurGlen Outlets and YVR Airport/WestJet Departures); OSM record does not specify which. Address and phone above are assigned to McArthurGlen based on coordinate proximity and public accessibility.

YVR Airport location (hula.yvr@gmail.com) is listed under WestJet Departures and may be post-security/airside, which would make it inaccessible to non-travelling cyclists — if this OSM node actually refers to that location, status should be revisited.
No address or phone in OSM tags; address and phone populated from website's McArthurGlen listing and require field verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active poke bowl chain with a confirmed Richmond location; publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists seeking a fresh, filling meal near the YVR corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labelled 'VEGAN FRIENDLY' (e.g. Yuzu Traditional, Koko Spicy Korean, Ponzu, Cali Veg) and 'GLUTEN FRIENDLY'; Sweet Potato and Tofu protein options available
